statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The symptoms are directly related to the patient's underlying cardiac conditions
